name: prospection-enr
description: Application de prospection fonciere pour projets d'energies renouvelables en France

scripts.build: npm run build -w @enr/core && npm run build -w @enr/scoring && npm run build -w @enr/api && npm run build -w @enr/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:netlify
scripts.demarrer: npm run build && npm run start -w @enr/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @enr/api" "npm run dev -w @enr/web"
